purpose: Read-only audit of three external Unreal MCP repositories as capability donors for the UE4.27 bridge. No code was copied or migrated. Companion prose: docs/EXTERNAL_MCP_DONOR_AUDIT.md.

monolith.license: MIT (ATTRIBUTION.md notes concept inspired by PolyForm-Noncommercial unreal-api-mcp, reimplemented from scratch; keep the attribution note with any borrowed design)
monolith.architecture: one plugin, 20 C++ modules, ~1387 actions; HTTP JSON-RPC on localhost:9316 plus stdio proxy (Scripts/monolith_proxy.py) with health poll and tools/list_changed; namespace-dispatch (25 dispatcher tools + monolith_discover) instead of flat catalog
monolith.transport: HTTP (violates our native-pipe protocol; transport code is reference-only, never a port target)
monolith.transactions: FScopedTransaction on every mutating action; validation before the transaction opens
monolith.progress_cancellation: minimal; async indexers report status, no cancellation

ultimateunrealenginemcp.architecture: TypeScript MCP server (133 tools, 26 domains, zod) + C++ plugin over TCP:55557 with correlation IDs; clean split of headless file-system tools (C++ parsing/codegen/UBT, no editor) from live-editor tools
ultimateunrealenginemcp.transactions: Modify()/MarkBlueprintAsModified on writes; no server-side undo stack
ultimateunrealenginemcp.tests: 1021 vitest tests, 43 suites, all mock-based (no live editor needed)

unreal-mcp-ue4.architecture: Node MCP server + UE4 Python Remote Execution (UDP multicast discovery + TCP command channel); ~90 Python handler scripts; 34 namespace tools with manage_tools.list_namespaces discovery; no C++ plugin
unreal-mcp-ue4.transport: UDP/TCP Python remote execution (equivalent to our opt-in legacy lane, never the native path)
unreal-mcp-ue4.transactions: none; mutations are unwrapped Python (below our bar)
unreal-mcp-ue4.tests: 30+ live e2e smoke scripts with PASS/FAIL harness and asset cleanup
unreal-mcp-ue4.honesty_note: explicitly excludes Blueprint graph inspection/authoring as unreliable from stock UE4.27 Python - independent confirmation that our C++ builder lane is the only viable UE4.27 route
